title: Mise overview
fetchPolicy: Remote checks fetch only: never push, pull, or bootstrap automatically. R refreshes local state.
previewWarning: Preview only. Incoming preview lists the files pull will write; diffs never apply anything. Trusted mise templates can execute their configured functions during inspection.
truncated: Preview exceeded the display limit. Applying is disabled; inspect the full plan in a terminal.
confirm.pull: This writes incoming tracked files, including common configuration. Conflicts are never resolved automatically. The terminal will show a fresh preview and ask for yes.
confirm.publish: This pushes saved dotfile history to your configured origin and fetches incoming changes. It does not write incoming files. The terminal will ask for yes.
confirm.bootstrap: This applies common AND selected-profile declarations, including packages, services, repositories, tools, hooks, and tasks. A terminal opens for a fresh preview, confirmation, and any privilege prompts.
declarationsChanged: Configuration declarations changed. Review bootstrap before applying.
pendingOperations: An interrupted mise operation needs attention. Inspect mise dot recover in a terminal.
planCoverage: Resource plans include current and desired state. Hooks/tasks run every time; repositories are checked locally, not fetched. Use the full bootstrap preview for all stages.
